claims.claim_text: Democrats are committed to creating a society where children are safe and can thrive physically, emotionally, educationally, and spiritually.
Bernie Sanders has the strongest platform for immigrant rights of any of the Democratic candidates.
Democrats believe they can and must do better for children, educators, and the country.
Mainstream Democrats are hopelessly compromised by their donor class of capitalists.

Republicans prioritized a rush vote on Amy Coney Barrett while millions were waiting on relief from the pandemic, and Democratic party leadership failed to use the many procedural tools they’d promised to use to delay the process.
